name: ZEN widgets
description: Custom field plus site-wide script injection to embed third-party ZEN widgets from zenwidgets.com into entities.
project_description:
Easily add powerful functionality from ZEN widgets to any entity with the provided custom field.

 Powerful functionality with 0 configuration and no maintenance, installed and operational in just a few minutes.

 Features 
 
 Site search 
 Opening hours 
 Vacancies 
 Download wall 
 Frequently asked questions 
 Contact form 
 Newsletter subscription 
 Locations map 
 Countdown banner 
 Media gallery 
 Testimonials 
 ...and more 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 You need an active ZEN widgets account where you can create and manage your widgets.

 Back to top
